answers.text: "An hourly reaction is not a template or volume failure." Agreed, and my claim never said failure. C5 forbids buying inside the reaction: D 2.7% under 20-day high, H1 below EMA9 at 40% of the day's range. The MA stack and rs_rank are not my tests. W 9>21 HH/HL says the trend is established; my entry is the new high after the reaction, not today. Not conceded.

"day_vol 1.36, under 1.40. Under +40% is a rejection." A 1.40 volume gate is not my rule; fill difficulty is NOT_SERVED and day_vol is only a partial proxy (R5). My test is C5 on the grid: W 9>21 HH/HL 0.6% under 20-wk high, D HH/HL 0.6% under 20-day high, H1 87% of the day's range - a leader at its high with HOG confirming (C14), which the refuter also confirms. Not conceded.

"day_vol 1.38 a near miss under the 1.40 bar." The volume bar is not my test (R5). The refuter confirms my claim: W HH/HL 0.3% under 20-wk high, D HH/HL 0.3% under 20-day high, H1 97% of range. Rank 245 is a C12 weight I accept - MA and V are the group's lead pair, BRK-B a follower - but the new-high claim stands. Not conceded.
